When you define limit_choices_to={'role': RoleChoices.PHARMACIST} directly on the model, DRF automatically restricts the lookup queryset for that field behind the scenes. If you pass an ID (like "2") that belongs to a user who is not a pharmacist, DRF's built-in PrimaryKeyRelatedField filters them out entirely during the initial query lookup. Because it cannot find user "2" inside the restricted pharmacist pool, it throws the generic "object does not exist" error before it ever reaches your custom validate_pharmacist method.
To override this behavior and force DRF to look up any user so it can return your clean, custom error message, you must explicitly declare the pharmacist field in the serializer using a full CustomUser queryset
